source: NASA PO.DAAC, JPL GRACE/GRACE-FO mascon grid (Earthdata Login)

variable.definition: Change in all water on and under the land (snow, soil, lakes, groundwater), as an equivalent water depth relative to the 2004-2009 average, measured from Earth's gravity.

grid.grid_reference: lat0/lon0 are the centre of the south-west cell; rows go north, columns east

processing: each solution assigned to its window-midpoint month (next free month if taken); calendar months without a solution kept as NaN
coarsened the 0.5 deg grid to 2 deg cells (edges at multiples of 2 from -90 / -180), each native cell split by footprint overlap
cell value = mean of native land cells weighted by cos(latitude) x overlap fraction
kept source units (cm liquid water equivalent); float32 with zlib compression
caveats: Values are anomalies relative to the 2004-2009 mean, not absolute water amounts.
Effective resolution is ~3 deg (~300 km): neighbouring 2 deg cells are not independent; per-cell significance overstates detail.
Glaciers and ice sheets (Greenland, Antarctica, Alaska) count as land in the product mask: their large negative values are ice loss, not groundwater.
